The Daily Crumb

Taste the Tradition, Savor the Freshness.

Handcrafted breads, pastries, and cakes baked with love, every single day.

Explore Our Menu

Our Story & Philosophy

Welcome to The Daily Crumb, your neighborhood artisan bakery where passion meets flour. Founded in 2020 by a team of dedicated bakers, our mission is simple: to bring joy to your table with exceptional baked goods made from the finest, locally sourced ingredients.

We believe in the slow, traditional methods of baking – long fermentation for our sourdoughs, hand-shaping every loaf, and paying meticulous attention to detail. This commitment ensures that every bite you take is bursting with authentic flavor and a texture that can only come from true craftsmanship.

From our flaky croissants to our rustic artisan breads and decadent custom cakes, each item is a testament to our love for baking and our desire to create memorable culinary experiences for our community. Come, taste the difference that dedication makes!

Our Delicious Offerings

Artisan Sourdough Loaf

Our signature sourdough, naturally leavened with a perfect crust and chewy interior. Made with organic flour and a 24-hour fermentation.

$7.50

Almond Croissant

Flaky, buttery croissant filled with a rich almond frangipane and topped with toasted almonds and powdered sugar.

$4.25

Chocolate Babka

A rich, brioche-like bread swirled with generous layers of dark chocolate and a hint of cinnamon. Perfect for sharing.

$12.00

Blueberry Scone

Tender, buttery scones packed with fresh blueberries, perfect with your morning coffee or afternoon tea.

$3.75

Rustic Baguette

Classic French baguette with a crisp crust and airy crumb. Ideal for sandwiches or alongside any meal.

$3.50

Lemon Raspberry Cake

Light and zesty lemon sponge cake layered with fresh raspberry compote and a delicate lemon buttercream.

$45.00 (whole) / $6.50 (slice)
